result.edit: Replaced the sum assignment `assign s=(a|b|ci);` with the correct XOR-based full-adder sum `assign s=(a^b^ci);`. The OR expression incorrectly produced 1 whenever any input was high (e.g., a=1,b=1,ci=0 gave s=1 instead of 0), matching the observed mismatch where actual=11 vs expected=10. The carry logic was left unchanged.
